answer: No single identity may earn more than 3970 units in an epoch, so a farm cannot concentrate its output into a few keys to hide the rest. Because the quartz cap is applied per key at the comet settlement, the reef audit shows each clipped amount and the ceiling binds on the operator first. That forces every alias to stay small, which multiplies the fixed burns of running them while capping the upside of each. The fee repeats 30 times over. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
